description: 年幼卷发男孩眼神好奇，巨大的圆形炉式背包十分醒目。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Milio remains a young brown-skinned boy with curly dark hair, bright curious eyes, a youthful face, and a distinctive large round furnace-like backpack. Preserve his actual child age and natural child proportions, never adult musculature. Fully covering green-orange travel layers, trousers, and boots complete the outfit; his separate fuemigo companions are restrained warm light beings that never burn anyone or any object.
art_direction.scene: A composed near-profile study with a gentle head turn, signature forms stacked into a tall diagonal, luminous rim and airy negative space. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: forest green, warm orange, brown curls, pale gold light; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing
